narrative: The June 6 Flowise coverage concludes two CVSS-9-plus agent-framework RCEs in successive weeks make self-hosted agent platforms an active attack surface and urges treating tool configuration as untrusted, echoed by Obsidian's PoC and the NSA note that multi-MCP agents lack privilege isolation. remaining_gap: Evidence is broad agent-execution abuse, not the named secret-exfiltration sub-category, and shows no CIS/OWASP top-list placement.
